message.content:
If you mean **iCloud Control** as the macOS utility, it was a Finder add-on for **selective sync** in iCloud Drive: you could remove selected items locally, download them again later, and publish a public link from Finder.[1] The project has been **retired** because macOS Catalina (10.15) added similar built-in functionality, and it is no longer maintained.[1]

If you mean **Apple’s iCloud controls/settings**, Apple provides official ways to manage storage, backups, and syncing from **iCloud Settings** on Apple devices, **iCloud.com**, and **iCloud for Windows**.[5][6][7][8]

If you want, I can help with one of these specifically:
- **iCloud Control** for older macOS versions
- **Managing iCloud settings** on iPhone, Mac, Windows, or web
- **Downloading or installing** the old iCloud Control utility
